data.title: Ferretti Group Names Elisabetta Cugnasca Head of Investor Relations and Sustainability
data.description:

data.title: Telefônica Brasil Approves R$500 Million Interest on Capital Distribution
data.description:

Shareholders on record as of September 25, 2026 will be entitled to receive the payment, expected by April 30, 2027, with the per-share amount subject to adjustment depending on activity under the company’s ongoing share buyback program and differentiated tax treatments.

The announcement underscores Telefônica Brasil’s continued shareholder-remuneration policy, reinforcing its capital-return strategy in Brazil’s telecom sector while allowing flexibility to recalibrate per-share proceeds if share repurchases reduce the outstanding float. Institutional and cross-border investors will need to manage documentation for special tax regimes by early October, highlighting the operational and tax-compliance considerations tied to this distribution.

data.title: Arandu Investimentos Updates Share Valuation Ahead of Tender Offer
data.description:

The updated valuation, prepared using a discounted cash flow methodology, increased the indicated value of the company’s shares from R$0.60 to R$0.66, while the tender offer price remains set at R$0.67 per share, subject to pro rata adjustment by changes in the SELIC rate until the auction settlement, signaling a modest premium to appraised value and clarifying terms for minority shareholders evaluating the offer.

data.title: Westwater Updates Battery-Grade Graphite Strategy and Progress
data.description:
Westwater Resources ( (WWR) ) has provided an announcement.

The materials highlighted Westwater’s progress on its Kellyton Graphite Plant, where more than half of the planned $245 million capital cost has been invested and an EXIM loan approved, as well as its broader mine-to-market graphite strategy centered on U.S. battery demand.

The update underscored that Phase 1 of the Kellyton facility is designed to provide 12,500 mtpa of battery-grade natural graphite, with Phase 2 expected to lift capacity to 50,000 mtpa, supported by ongoing customer qualification and offtake discussions.
